ConfigValueMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts a config value to type T.
    If T is a config object, maybe it should be annotated with @ConfigMapper so Kora can generate ConfigValueMapper<T>.
    If the app should receive T directly from a config path, maybe T should be annotated with @ConfigSource("path.to.value") instead.
    If T is a custom scalar type, provide a ConfigValueMapper<T> component or module method. For collections/maps, also check that element/value type mappers exist.
